The '''Battle of the Phindar Spaceport''' was a battle that took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] attacked the [[Phindar Spaceport]] to try and [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].

==Prelude==
At [[Château Malreaux]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was ordered by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to bring Jedi Master [[Jai Maruk]] before him alive so that his "treaty" between him and Yoda would be complete. However, after scarring Maruk, she believed that he should have been made "number seventeen" in her list of dead Jedi. Dooku's plan was set in stone. Ventress watched from her ship, [[Last Call (Ginivex-class)|''Last Call'']], as what seemed to look like Yoda entered a starship. She then followed him to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] and destroyed the escort pilots. But after realizing through the Force that "Yoda" was actually an [[Actor/Legends|actor]] named [[Palleus Chuff]], playing as a decoy, she then decided that it would be best to capture him and destroy the ship to make it look like Yoda had perished.<ref name="YDR" />

==The battle==
The events on Ithor caused the Republic spirit to deteriorate, much to Ventress's liking. However, she was furious when news stated that she was known for killing ''eleven'' Jedi. Despite that, she continued her objective and hired a [[FIII Footman droid]] named [[Solis]] to give her the location of the real Yoda's whereabouts. Ventress took eighteen [[A-series assassin droid]]s on the ''Last Call'' and unsuccessfully ambushed [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] Yoda on [[Phindar Station]], but managed to slay Masters Maruk and [[Maks Leem]]. Unbeknownst to Ventress, Chuff escaped and helped Yoda destroy the ''Last Call''.<ref name="YDR" />
